# Two-Key concept

Authorization layer for AI agents. A tool call runs only if Path A (a policy VM)
and Path B (a judge quorum) both allow. Prototype. Apache-2.0.
Not the full Insomniac-VibeLabs/two-key repository.

Package: two-key-concept
Import: two_key
Current tag: v0.1.3
Not on PyPI. Install from git.

Does: signed constitution, Path A bytecode, Path B judges (xAI/Grok, OpenAI,
Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama), monitored agents, encrypted ledger, single-use token.
Does not: scanning, antivirus, DLP, PKI, chain anchoring, seed phrases.

Read README.md, then docs/HOWTO.md. Tests: python -m unittest discover -s tests
